## Summary
- add the recovered RTE Opus UI/UX Claude design audit bundle under docs/audit/rte-opus-uiux-claude-design-audit
- update docs placement policy so docs/audit is an explicit active docs root
- add a task packet and proof JSON with source and destination checksum evidence
- keep the bundle as audit evidence only; no runtime, prompt, schema, or service files change

## Scope
- documentation audit artifacts only
- docs hygiene policy recognition for docs/audit
- task packet and proof for repo traceability
- no generated artifact rewrites outside repo-required docs normalization

## Validation
- task packet JSON parses and validates against dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- proof JSON parses
- source and destination SHA-256 hashes are recorded after docs normalization
- git diff --check passes for the changed paths
- pre-commit passes for the changed files
